a.name: A. Get to the Ship
a.imagePath: vassal_extracted/images/mission-cards/Mos Eisley Outskirts-A-Get to the Ship.png
a.setup: A figure can interact with a launch panel to flip the token Green side up or gray side up. Each player can flip a maximum of 1 token per round.
a.endOfRound: Each player gains 5 VPs for each green launch panel they control and 2 VPs for each gray launch panel they control.

vpPerLaunchPanelControlled.vpMessage: launch panels controlled (5 VP green / 2 VP gray)

b.name: B. Smuggled Goods
b.setup: A figure can retrieve contraband as a free action. Apply -2 Speed to each figure carrying contraband.
b.endOfRound: Each player gains 15 VPs for each of their figures carrying contraband in their deployment zone. Then discard those tokens.

vpPerContrabandInDeploymentZone.vpMessage: contraband carried in deployment zone (15 VP each)

a.name: Local Trouble
a.setup:
Thugs are hostile to all figures except other thugs.
A figure can attack a thug (Health: 4, Defense: 1 black die)
a.persistent:
Thugs are hostile to all figures except other thugs.
A figure can attack a thug (Health: 4, Defense: 1 black die)
a.endOfRound:
Move each thug 2 spaces to the closest hostile figure. Then, each hostile figure adjacent to a thug suffers 2 Damage. (If multiple hostile figures are tied for closest to the thug, then the player with Initiative decides which figure is targeted.)
The player who controls the Cantina gains 6 VPs.

b.name: Sabacc Standoff
b.startOfRound: The player with the Initiative places 1 token next to the Cantina for each Command card in their hand.
b.endOfRound: Until the end of the next round, the player who controls the Sabacc table is considered to have 1 additional VP for each token next to the Cantina.

vpPerTokenForControllingCell.vpMessage: controlling the Sabacc table ({count} Cantina token(s) at 1 VP each)

a.name: Krykna Infestation
a.persistent:
Kryknas are neutral figures (Health: 8, Defense: 2 Blocks). Krykna can suffer Damage and be targeted by attacks and abilities that can target hostile figures.
When a player defeats a Krykna, that player gains 2 VPs and claims that Krykna.
a.endOfRound: In order of initiative, each player chooses and pushes a Krykna up to 3 spaces, ending in a space adjacent to the most non-Krykna figures possible. Repeat this process until all Krykna have been chosen. Then, each non-Krykna figure adjacent to a Krykna suffers 2 Damage. Then, each player may place 1 of his claimed Krykna in his opponents deployment zone.

b.name: Powered Perimeter
b.setup: Set aside 1 blue, 1 green, and 1 red neutral mission token face down.
b.startOfRound: Each player randomly reveals 1 set aside mission token. Place 1 strain token on each signal market that matches a revealed mission token. Flip the revealed tokens face down.
b.endOfRound: Each player removes all Strain tokens from signal markers they control, gaining 2 VPs for each Strain token removed this way.

vpPerStrainOnControlledSpaces.vpMessage: signal markers controlled ({count} strain removed × 2 VP)

a.name: Blitz
a.setup: Players do not deploy normally. instead, players alternate deploying groups, following the rules for passing. When a figure is deployed, it may move up to 8 spaces.
a.endOfRound: Each player gains 2 VPs for each critical position that player controls.

b.name: Fluctuations
b.endOfRound:
Each player gains 1 VP for each fluctuation they control. Each figure on a fluctuation gains a Power Token based on its color: (Blue: Evade Token), (Green: Block Token), (Red: Damage Token), (Yellow: Surge Token)

Then, in order of initiative, each player may swap 1 fluctuation with another. A fluctuation cannot be moved twice in the same round.

a.name: Arms Salvage
a.startOfRound: Place 1 Power Token on each crate, according to that crate's color: (Red: Damage Token), (Yellow: Surge Token), (Blue: Block Token)
a.endOfRound: For each crate a player controls, that player may distribute the Power Tokens on that crate among friendly figures on or adjacent to that crate. Then, that player gains 2 VPs.

b.name: Secure Munitions
b.persistent:
Doors are locked.

A figure can attack a crate (Health: 5, Defense: 1 Block). When a crate is destroyed, all figures and objects on or adjacent to that crate suffer 2 Damage.

For each crate in a player's deployment zone, that player counts as having 6 additional VPs.
b.endOfRound: For each terminal a player controls, that player chooses and opens 1 door. Then, each player pushes each crate they control up to 3 spaces.

a.name: Gaining Favor
a.setup: The player with initiative claims 4 red mission tokens. Then, his opponent claims 4 blue mission tokens.
a.persistent: A figure can interact with a patron its player controls to place 1 of its player's mission tokens on that patron. Each player counts as having a number of VPs based on the number of patrons with 1 of his mission tokens: 1=2 VPs, 2=5 VPs, 3=10 VPs, 4=20 VPs.

b.name: Line of Fire
b.persistent:
A figure can retrieve a crate. Each figure can carry only 1 crate. A small figure carrying a crate cannot attack.

Crates have 5 Health. When an attack targeting a small figure is declared, that figure may choose for a crate it is carrying to suffer up to 3 Block. Then, apply +X Damage to the results, where X is the Block the crate just suffered.

When a figure carrying a crate enters the extraction point, discard that crate and that figure scores 10 VPs minus 2 VPs for each Block that crate has suffered.

a.name: The Art of Robotics
a.persistent: End of each Round: For each terminal he controls, each player may choose 1 Droid prototype and move it up to 4 spaces. Then, each player who controls at least 1 Droid prototype gains 8 VPs.

b.name: Experimental Weapons
b.persistent:
A figure can retrieve a weapon prototype. A figure can carry only 1 weapon prototype.

A figure carrying a weapon prototype applies -1 Block to its defense results and gains: Surge: Perform an attack. Before performing the attack, you become Focused. Hit+Hit: Gain 3 VPs. Hit+Hit: Move up to 4 spaces and recover 3 Strain.

a.name: Inside Job
a.persistent:
While a figure inside its own deployment zone is defending, apply -1 Block to the defense results.

While a figure inside its opponent's deployment zone is defending, apply +1 Evade to the defense results.
a.endOfRound: Each player scores 3 VPs for each deployment zone they control. Then, if a player controls the Command Center, that player scores 3 VPs.

b.name: Bomb Drop
b.persistent:
A figure can retrieve an explosive.

Figures carrying 1 or more explosives gain:
Special Action ("Bomb Drop"): Discard 1 explosive you are carrying and choose a space within 3 spaces. Each figure on or adjacent to the chosen space suffers 2 Damage.
b.endOfRound: Each figure in an opponent's deployment zone carrying 1 or more explosives discards all carried explosives and gains 4 VPs for each explosive discarded.

vpPerContrabandInOpponentDeploymentZone.vpMessage: explosive(s) discarded in opponent's deployment zone (4 VP each)
